title: How Do I Feel Today?
developmental_focus: Emotional vocabulary building and self-recognition. Ages 2-3 are developing the ability to label basic emotions (happy, sad, angry, scared, surprised) in themselves and others.
safety_notes: One clear, unambiguous emotion per spread — no blended or conflicting facial expressions.
No scary, threatening, or grotesque imagery; 'angry' and 'scared' depicted gently, resolved with reassurance by end of book.
Character designs consistent across all spreads (same character model sheet).
Text kept to 3-6 words per page, simple present-tense sentences.
